resources.string: Kernel flasher
Flash an AnyKernel3 kernel ZIP using root.
Requires root and a working Magisk, KernelSU or APatch BusyBox. Other ZIP formats and boot images are not supported.

Only flash a package from a source you trust, built for your exact device and ROM. Its scripts and native tools run as root and can modify boot partitions, data and device security. An incompatible or interrupted flash can prevent Android from starting. Keep a known working boot image and a way to restore it outside Thor.

Flashing cannot be cancelled after it starts. ZIP validation checks the format, not compatibility or safety. Thor will not automatically reboot, retry or restore the previous kernel.

Before you flash
Use a trusted ZIP for your exact device and keep a recovery image. You will confirm before flashing.
Both slots (A + B)

Runs the entire installer twice: current slot, then inactive. Use only a package whose author supports repeated installation on both installed systems. This can replace both kernels, remove the untouched fallback and repeat shared changes. Failure can leave only one slot updated. Thor cannot roll back or change which slot boots next.
I understand both slots can be changed and this package supports both installed systems and repeated installation.
At least one pass succeeded, but both slots did not finish successfully. Review each pass in the log; no rollback was performed.
